method: Original workplace capstone retrieving earlier keigo in advanced documents. Relevant authored sections actually inspected. Neither this capstone nor publisher labels constitute an official N1 syllabus.

points.formation: Suru noun + いたす/いたします; selected お+verb stem or ご+suru noun constructions, with lexical compatibility.
points.teachingChoice: Actor remains own side. Humble wording does not establish completion or approval; ordinary team です・ます can be suitable.

points.form: Directed apology お詫び申し上げます
points.formation: Selected お/ご+verbal-noun stem+申し上げる; a selected expression, not universal attachment to every noun or verb.
points.teachingChoice: Name the wrong venue closing time and correction. A confirmed company error is not made conditional on the client feeling offended.

points.form: Considerate ご確認いただけますか
points.formation: ご+確認+いただけますか or verb te-form+いただけますか; speaker is receiver, listener performs the requested action.
points.teachingChoice: Request and deadline remain distinct from received approval. Combined politeness categories are not automatically double honorifics.

points.form: Past gratitude during an internal transfer
points.formation: Selected お世話になる: past なりました, ongoing なっております, contextual future なります.
points.teachingChoice: Japan Businessmail Association internal-transfer example explicitly combines past thanks and ongoing collaboration. The original scenario uses an internal transfer, not resignation.
